SLS.RemoveConfirm: Remove the loading screen configured for "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
SLS.NoConfig: This scene has no loading screen configured.
SLS.ApplyToSelectionTooltip: Apply current font colour and size to the selected text.
SLS.ClearSelectionStyleTooltip: Remove inline colour/size from the selected text.
SLS.ProgressLabelHint: Text shown beside the spinner above the progress bar. Leave blank to hide the label (the spinner stays).
SLS.FadeInHint: Milliseconds for the loading screen to fade in. Use 0 for instant.
SLS.FadeOutHint: Milliseconds for the loading screen to fade out. Use 0 for instant.
SLS.ShowProgressBarHint: Display a loading bar whilst the scene loads.
SLS.TextPlaceholder: Text shown over the picture (line breaks preserved).
SLS.AudioHint: If set, the video will be muted and this audio file plays instead.
SLS.VolumeHint: Playback volume for the video and audio (0–100%).
SLS.VolumeDownTooltip: Click and hold to keep decreasing.
SLS.VolumeUpTooltip: Click and hold to keep increasing.
SLS.FitHint: How the picture and video fill the screen.
SLS.DurationHint: Seconds. Leave blank to require the GM to close it manually.
SLS.SettingsPresetsHint: Create, edit, and delete reusable loading screen presets.
SLS.DeletePresetConfirm: Delete the preset "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
SLS.LoadPresetTooltip: Fill form with this preset's values
SLS.ResetDefaultsHint: Reset all fields to your saved defaults.
SLS.SaveDefaultsHint: Save the current form values as your baseline for new loading screens.
SLS.DefaultsSaved: Current values saved as your new defaults.
SLS.SettingsDefaultsHint: Your saved baseline values for new loading screens.
SLS.SettingsDebugHint: Enable detailed console messages for troubleshooting. Off by default.
